text:
kai: propose single opaque header X-RW-META for resume tokens, route hints, provenance. keep envelope small and versioned.

maria: yes to one header. less churn for SDKs.

ingrid: envelope format? base64(proto) with v1 prefix. define well-known fields, nothing freeform.

kai: draft: v1:base64("resume_id|attempt|route_hint|sample_bit|vis") where vis=public|private. proxies treat as opaque except validate hmac.

sam.w: security: HMAC mandatory. private visibility must not end up in logs. consider optional KMS encryption for high-sensitivity routes.
maria: add per-route config: retry.resume.enabled, retry.dedupe=off|best_effort|strict, resume.visibility=allow|block. default: disabled for side-effects.
ingrid: proxies must: 1) validate HMAC, 2) increment attempt on edge retry and resign, 3) drop header on HMAC failure and emit metric `resume.header.invalid`.
kai: also add Resume-Ack response header: Resume-Ack: v1|ok|resume_id when backend supports dedupe. helps avoid blind retries.
sam.w: sampling: sample_bit default 0; ops may enable cluster-wide low-rate sampling; route teams can opt-in. logs must store only trace-hash (8 bytes) to avoid PII.
maria: ops-bot please create rollout checklist: key rotation, kms fail-modes, per-route opt-in plan, metrics to watch.
ops-bot: created RW-3002: "X-RW-META rollout checklist" and notified #eng-oncall.
kai: I'll write RFC with schema, key policy, and rollout steps and tag infra/ops.
